description: Mapping from KITTI 2D object labels to the COCO categories predicted by every model. 'evaluate' classes are scored; 'ignore_for' classes become iscrowd=1 regions for the listed COCO categories, so detections inside them are neither true nor false positives.

Van.reason: COCO has no van class; detectors legitimately call vans car or truck (KITTI's own protocol also ignores Van when scoring Car)

Person_sitting.reason: A person in COCO; KITTI excludes it from Pedestrian

Cyclist.reason: COCO detectors box the rider as person and the bike as bicycle; neither matches a KITTI Cyclist box

Tram.reason: Closest COCO class is train, which is not evaluated

DontCare.reason: Unlabeled regions per the KITTI devkit

area: Box area w*h in original pixels (COCO uses mask area, so KITTI 'small/medium/large' buckets are slightly shifted toward larger objects)
split: Ultralytics KITTI val split (1,496 images drawn from the official KITTI 2D object training set), with the official KITTI label_2 files
